-- Create the log table
CREATE TABLE market_impact_cost_log (
    log_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    ordersmark TEXT,
    mic NUMERIC,
    calculated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Create the procedure
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE recalc_market_impact_cost()
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_mkteffect REAL;
BEGIN
    -- Get the current market factor (most recent mkteffect from systemmonitoring)
    SELECT mkteffect INTO v_mkteffect
    FROM systemmonitoring
    ORDER BY systemmonitoringpivot DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    -- Insert MIC calculation for new orders: MIC = dealcount * dealquote * mkteffect * 0.01
    INSERT INTO market_impact_cost_log (ordersmark, mic)
    SELECT 
        o.recordvault AS ordersmark,
        ROUND(CAST(o.dealcount * o.dealquote * v_mkteffect * 0.01 AS numeric), 4) AS mic
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.orderflow = 'New';
END;
$$;
